errors.calendar_read_only: That calendar cannot be written. Choose one of your calendars that can.
errors.change_pending: An earlier change to this event has not reached the calendar yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_calendar: Choose one of your own calendars that is on and can be written, or leave this out.
errors.invalid_color: A colour is written as #rrggbb, for example #0b8043.
errors.invalid_hours: Working hours need a known weekday (mon to sun), times as HH:MM, and an end after the start.
errors.invalid_kind: That is not a kind of event Scout can add. Choose from charge, appointment, meeting, travel, stay, show, reservation, delivery or expiry.
errors.invalid_minutes: Ask for a slot of 5 to 1,440 minutes.
errors.invalid_text: A title is needed, and the title, place and notes must not be too long.
errors.invalid_time_zone: Use an IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Lisbon.
errors.invalid_undo: That undo does not match this deleted event.
errors.invalid_when: Times are an RFC 3339 time with an offset or a YYYY-MM-DD date, both of the same kind, with the end after the start.
errors.invalid_window: Ask for a window that ends after it starts and is at most the longest allowed (a year for events, 62 days for free time).
errors.not_on_campbooks: Only an event on your Campbooks calendar can be added to a provider calendar, and only to a different one.
errors.not_pushed: This event was not added from your Campbooks calendar.
errors.series_not_editable: A series is changed one occurrence at a time. Name the occurrence.
